set.body: Acceptance criteria: exact timestamp-sequence and cardinality checks for every sample-preserving filter; a hand-computable Engbert-Kliegl linear ramp and irregular-grid requirement test; canonical I-DT fixtures for failed initial windows, isolated outliers, and expansion; I-VT missing-middle, off-screen-outer, and short-run cases; an occupancy support-mass identity; same-id different-spec frame and grid conflicts plus contains(clamp(p)); a one-direction sliced-Wasserstein identity counterexample; and non-vacuity assertions before universal event assertions. Each targeted defect has a deliberate mutant or equivalent pre-fix discriminator that the court rejects. Applicable fixtures execute on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Trust court: regression discriminators and mutation proof
